verdicts.title: A Pommaret bases approach to the degree of a polynomial ideal
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we study first the relationship between Pommaret bases and Hilbert series. Given a finite Pommaret basis, we derive new explicit formulas for the Hilbert series and for the degree of the ideal generated by it which exhibit more clearly the influence of each generator. Then we establish a new dimension depending Bézout bound for the degree and use it to obtain a dimension depending bound for the ideal membership problem.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Pommaret bases, Hilbert series, and Bézout-type degree bounds for polynomial ideals, with no mention of real radical dimension, random 3-CNF formulas, or communication complexity of disjointness.
